STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE — DISTRACTOR)
Solicitation No.: SYN-I-0009
Title: Cybersecurity Awareness Training Development

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall develop and deliver annual cybersecurity
awareness training modules for installation personnel, covering
phishing recognition, removable-media handling, and incident
reporting procedures.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Develop computer-based training modules compatible with the
    government learning management system.
2.2 Update modules annually to reflect current threat guidance.
2.3 Provide completion-tracking reports to the Information Systems
    Security Manager.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Contractor facility, with on-site kickoff at notional installation.
